Due to the weight of this item, it will require assistance with unloading & moving at point of delivery.

Versatile multi-material table saw that easily cuts steel, aluminium, wood and plastic, using just one Evolution TCT blade. Excellent at ripping thin stock, making accurate cross cuts and handling sheet goods. Features a high quality quick-clamp mitre guide and rip fence for maximum cutting stability, precise blade height and angle adjustment. Sliding carriage providies an extremely secure, smooth cutting motion.
